docs.text:
This site has moved

The HERO User Manual and its training resources now live on the new HERO Enablement site. Please update your bookmarks to the new address, then use the button below to continue.

Before you continue: the new HERO Enablement site is only available on the Hasbro network. Connect to the Hasbro VPN (Cisco Secure Client – AnyConnect VPN, server athreos.wizards.com) or to the Hasbro office network first.

Go to the HERO Enablement site →

New address: https://hero-enablement.apps.ai-dev.tiamat.cloud
